# Shared Python dependencies for SAM2 Adapter and SAM3 Adapter training.
# Supported environment: CPython 3.12 on Linux with an NVIDIA GPU.
#
# PyTorch is intentionally installed separately because its wheel must match the
# target server's NVIDIA driver. For an exact match to the validated workstation:
#   python -m pip install --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 \
#     torch==2.11.0 torchvision==0.26.0
# For another driver/CUDA combination, use the command generated by:
#   https://pytorch.org/get-started/locally/
# Install PyTorch before this file.

# SAM3 currently imports pkg_resources; setuptools 81 warns that this API is
# being removed. Keep the last compatible series until upstream migrates.
